criterion_text: An enabled writable Registry accepts OCI upload/manifest push via standard Distribution endpoints, publishes only after complete verified referenced objects, preserves byte/digest identity, and rejects incomplete/tampered/unauthorized uploads without visible tags.

verifiers.summary: SC-02: the writable loopback Registry publishes only a complete verified closure with preserved identity and rejects incomplete/tampered/unauthorized pushes without a visible tag
